read_file_contents: read a file and return its contents using the ReadFile function
read_file_suppress_errors: read a file with error printing disabled by setting print_error to False
review_ReadFile: review the ReadFile function that opens a file and returns its contents or None on error
summarize_ReadFile: summarize the ReadFile function which handles IOError and optionally prints error messages
test_ReadFile: test the ReadFile function by reading an existing file and verifying the returned contents
